realRuns.name: krea-2, visual prompt and style refinement
realRuns.observations: Detailed photographic portrait with bright red hair, amber eyes, white blouse, black necktie, golden backlighting and a foreshortened reaching hand. Hair strands, fabric folds and light are coherent, without visible decoder seams. It misses the reference painted anime rendering, pencil texture and glowing stylized eyes; the reaching hand is also soft and cropped. Nippon and the second style adapter were confirmed loaded at strength 1, but their declared trigger phrases are absent from this adapted prompt. This is a style mismatch, not evidence that the adapters failed to load.

realRuns.name: krea-2, visual prompt and style refinement
realRuns.observations: Clean photographic or realistic-rendered scene with two rusty round-headed robots on the left, a blindfolded white-bob-haired woman at the right, ruined buildings, dry vegetation and bright colored circles in the sky. It retains the principal subjects, but misses the reference oil-like painted textures, full-body ornate black dress and wide composition. The robot and character framing is much tighter, and the real-looking hair and skin strongly differ from the reference illustration. Painterly CE was confirmed loaded at strength 1; this single image does not establish how much it affected the result. No decoder seams are visible.

realRuns.name: krea-2, visual prompt and style refinement
realRuns.observations: Comparable photographic detail and warm sunlight, with natural dark hair, a blue off-shoulder blouse, white flowing skirt and white sneakers beside a textured painted wall. Skin, fabric folds and visible hand are coherent, without visible decoder seams. Pose and framing differ: she walks away while looking back instead of leaning toward the camera. Large graffiti lettering replaces the reference soft floral watercolor motifs, and the backlight is warmer. This assessment concerns photographic quality and broad aesthetic, rather than identical pose or wall design. Purple Aether was confirmed loaded at strength 1 on the denoiser; its effective contribution is not isolated by this single result.

realRuns.name: krea-2, visual prompt and style refinement
